description: Smithers maintains your codebase. It turns issues into reviewed, tested changes and keeps the project wiki current. Flows beside your code define how.

support.summary: The release candidate's required platform is Linux with Node 26.4.0.

animation.alt: Build targets form a dependency graph, and an edit re-runs only the steps it makes stale while the rest comes from cache.

install.cli:
git clone https://github.com/smithersai/smithers.git
cd smithers
pnpm install
cargo +1.98.0 build --locked --release -p smithers-ffi --bin smithers-jj-export
export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"
